children: The annual inflation rate in Mozambique eased for the second month to 6.45% in August 2026, marking the lowest since April.

Price growth softened for some CPI items, including food & non-alcoholic beverages (8.91% vs 12.62% in July); clothing & footwear (4.18% vs 4.81%); restaurants & hotels (3.98% vs 4.22%) and miscellaneous goods & services (3.48% vs 3.57%).
Transportation prices also rose at a slower pace, easing to 14.77% from 14.87%, but remained elevated overall.
On a monthly basis, the CPI fell by 0.28% in August, after a 0.26% decrease in the prior month.
The main downward contributors were tomatoes (-16.3%), lettuce (-9.8%), and cabbage (-6.7%), followed by onions (-2.8%), butter beans (-1.6%), horse mackerel (-0.6%), and restaurant meals (-0.3%).

title: Mozambique Inflation Rate Slows to 4-Month Low in August
